comment: Boss debug-room mapping + behavior draft (#493, tool at #/boss-room). Bosses are arena-bound: behavior is mapped inside the boss's own stage, not a flat sandbox. `arena` is the default (taken from the quest that spawns the boss today); the tool can load any z-arena. Sibling file to enemy_attacks.json. v2 adds per-boss `phases` / `attacks` / `anchors` — DRAFT tables read off the rig clip vocabularies (spec /states/bosses), to be corrected by observation in the room before any Godot implementation. Unset attack fields default per /mechanics/enemy-attacks. `chain` is a clip-token sequence (tokens ending in `lp` loop); `anchors` are authored with the room's click tool and are positions in the boss's default arena frame.

s04z_na1.label: Makara Ruins arena
s04z_na1.note: the_broken_seal's boss segment loads this stage but spawns no enemy (scripted event)

phases.label: Grounded
phases.note: walks the arena (wlk1), full melee + fireball kit; opens with the tht roar

phases.label: Airborne
phases.note: takes off (flst), flies away, drops the sky cluster-fireball, and deals damage where it lands

phases.label: Enraged
phases.note: low health: growls (tht) and the model edges turn red; more aggressive — modifier overlay on the ground/flight cycle, not a separate moveset

attacks.note: walk and bite (atkh1 quick bite)
runs toward the player (wlk2) and bites (atkh2 heavy bite)
walk and tail swipe (left)
walk and tail swipe (right)
wing flap blows the player away along the facing and deals damage
war cry with a blast radius in a circle around the dragon
fires three fireballs while standing — one per brslp rep; brs1 (0.5s) likely the single-shot variant
flies away, then deals damage in a circle where it lands
from the air: a fireball at the ground that splits into 3 parts

clip_notes.tht: war cry — fight opener, the war_cry blast attack, and the enrage growl
clip_notes.claw: landed-on-claws pose (0.17s — stance, not an attack)
clip_notes.rdst: landing-dive start? (the fly-away return approach — unverified)
clip_notes.dmg1: long stagger (2.17s) — the damage-break punish reaction

phases.label: Submerged
phases.note: untargetable; relocates between surfacing anchors (float reads as the underwater move)

phases.label: Surfaced
phases.note: attack set runs from a surfacing spot; body is the target

phases.label: Tired (punish)
phases.note: wattir idle after an attack string — the punish window; recovers via wttr2wt then submerges

attacks.note: water jet at the player; spwat/sp2wat are the spout-stance idles/transitions
spew AoE — vmply/vmwat read as the vomit-stance loop/idle; payload (poison?) unverified
suck-in → grab-eat; abscnc/eatcnc are the damage-interrupt cancels — the grab is breakable

clip_notes.wattir: tired idle — the post-string punish window
clip_notes.collisn: collision reaction — reads as the ram-into-wall (or player-collision) stun, not an attack

octo_diablo.note: no ded clip in the rig — death presentation is likely scripted (sinks?); tentacle clips (tt*/st*) never imported (see storybook/enemyData.ts import notes)

phases.label: Downed (punish)
phases.note: fall → fallwat fallen idle (weak point exposed) → stdup; entered on a damage/break threshold — open question which

attacks.note: charge st→lp then the 1.92s firing sweep
press/grind — hedbhitlp is the grinding-on-hit loop, hedb2wt2/hedb2lp the recover transitions
full st/lp/ed combo string (the only complete 3-piece family on the rig)

chaos_mobius.note: behavior draft blocked on clip import: GLB carries a single clip (z003_atk_dl_lp, a bare lp segment) — the rest of the kit's segmented pieces (ve_*) never imported; see storybook/enemyData.ts import notes

clip_notes.atk_dl_lp: the only imported clip — a loop segment of a segmented attack (dl = drill?); unplayable alone per /mechanics/enemy-attacks segment rules

phases.label: Engaged
phases.note: walks (walk) and runs the ranged kit; nagi sweep up close

phases.label: Submerged
phases.note: sinks (down) and swims (swm) to relocate between anchors, rises (up) — up/down could instead be a knockdown punish pair, verify in the room

attacks.note: 2.17s wide mow-down sweep
looping throw volley — lp repeats while firing
spread shot (diffusion release after the charge loop)
big radial burst; radwat/rad2wat are the radiating idle/recover
single heavy shot — bhsht reading uncertain (black-hole shot?)
